ios.desc:
AI-powered task management with subscription and expense tracking.

ABOUT MINDDRAFT

MindDraft helps you capture tasks naturally using AI, while also giving you visibility into your subscriptions and expenses — all in one place.

Designed for people who want clarity across daily tasks and recurring financial commitments.

AI TASK CAPTURE

Create tasks using natural language — by typing or speaking.

Examples:
• “Call dentist tomorrow at 3 PM” → Task with date, time, and reminder
• “Pay rent on the 1st every month” → Recurring task
• “Netflix $15.99 monthly” → Subscription entry created

MindDraft analyzes context to extract relevant details and organize items automatically.

VOICE ASSISTANT

Capture tasks hands-free when needed.

• Speech-to-text task creation
• Real-time transcription and parsing
• Supports multiple languages
• Useful while driving, walking, or multitasking

SUBSCRIPTION & EXPENSE TRACKING

Track recurring payments and expenses alongside your tasks.

• View subscriptions in one dashboard
• See monthly spending summaries
• Renewal reminders
• Expense logging via voice, camera, or text
• Budget insights and trends

PRODUCTIVITY INSIGHTS

Understand your task habits over time.

• Daily activity overview
• Completion streaks
• Heatmaps and timelines
• Weekly summaries
• Personalized suggestions

ORGANIZATION & VIEWS

Flexible ways to view and manage your tasks.

• Automatic categorization
• Priority-based sorting
• Timeline, Calendar, and Heatmap views
• Smart collections
• Search and filters

APPLE ECOSYSTEM SUPPORT

Designed to work seamlessly across devices.

• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Apple Watch app
• Siri Shortcuts
• iCloud sync
• Dark mode and custom themes
• Focus mode

MINDDRAFT PRO

Optional upgrade includes:

• Unlimited AI task parsing
• Advanced subscription and expense tracking
• Additional views and themes
• Apple Watch support
• Email-to-task capture
• Priority support

Free trial available. Subscription required for Pro features.

PRIVACY

Your data is private and secure.

• iCloud-based sync
• No ads
• No third-party tracking
• No data selling

Download MindDraft and organize your tasks and subscriptions in one place.

Support: help@minddraft.ai

Terms of Use: https://minddraft.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://minddraft.ai/privacy

show_hn.title: Show HN: MindDraft – AI task app with smart actions and auto expense tracking

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I built MindDraft because I was tired of task apps that made ME do all the work. After 18 months of solo development, I'm sharing it here.

*What's different:*

1. Location-based reminders - "Buy groceries" alerts when you're near a grocery store, not at an arbitrary time. Uses iOS geofencing.

2. Smart Actions - Tasks have action buttons. "Call dentist" → tap to call. "Pay rent" → opens payment app. Tasks become actions, not just reminders.

3. Task → Expense - Complete "Buy laptop $1200" and it auto-logs as an expense. No separate expense app.

4. Natural language AI - "Meeting with John Friday 3pm, need to prep slides day before" → parsed correctly with subtask.

*Tech stack:*
- SwiftUI + SwiftData
- Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions)
- Gemini 2.5 Flash for NLP
- Native iOS (no React Native/Flutter)

*What I learned:*
- Geofencing on iOS is powerful but battery-conscious (system decides when to fire)
- Gemini is surprisingly good at task parsing with proper prompting
- SwiftData is ready for production, but migrations need care

Free tier available. Premium unlocks more views and unlimited AI.

iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/minddraft-ai-daily-planner/id6748885432

Happy to answer technical questions about the implementation.
